summary: List the cached DNS checks of hosts

200.description: The cached results of the proxy, redirection and 404 hosts the user may view; none for a host not checked since the last restart or change

description:
Answers what the last checks found, without any lookup. A host's result is dropped when the host changes, is enabled, disabled or deleted. The provider read in a result exists only for a user who manages certificates.

Needs: the view right of each host type (a type the user may not view is left out)
